# Build AI From Here

> Build AI From Here (AI Growth Community LLC) teaches practical AI to Charlotte-area small businesses, real estate professionals, and everyday people — no coding, no overwhelm, just practical AI, one small win at a time. It offers AI consulting led by the $199 Pro AI Audit, a free-and-Premium community on Skool, live weekly build sessions in Charlotte, NC, and a bench of its own AI tools.

Key facts:
- Location: Charlotte, North Carolina (serving Charlotte, Concord, and Cabarrus County)
- Run by: Frank and Rico, two AI product builders
- Headline offer: Pro AI Audit, $199 — a one-on-one diagnostic that names the single bottleneck costing a business the most and hands over a written plan. Book first, pay after.
- Community: Build AI From Here on Skool — Free tier (daily AI tip, weekly tool video, starter prompt packs, monthly open Q&A) and Premium at $10/month (full prompt library, courses, Book Briefs, member pricing)
- Live sessions: a build session every Thursday, 6:00 PM ET, at Collaboration Central, Charlotte, NC; plus a monthly Automation Lab
- Contact: grow@buildaifromhere.com · (704) 900-1645

- [Home](https://buildaifromhere.com/): Start here — the audit, the community, the tools, and the weekly Thursday build sessions.

- [Community](https://buildaifromhere.com/community): The Skool community — Free and Premium ($10/month) tiers explained.
- [Our Tools](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools): The software we have built and run ourselves.
- [Charlotte](https://buildaifromhere.com/charlotte): Local programs — Thursday build sessions, the Automation Lab, the Builder's Cohort, Build School, and AI Breakfast (planned).
- [Learn](https://buildaifromhere.com/learn): Plain-English guides to practical AI, grouped by track.
- [Free starter prompt pack](https://buildaifromhere.com/prompt-pack): Twelve copy-and-paste prompts for business owners, realtors, and everyday jobs.
- [About](https://buildaifromhere.com/about): Who runs Build AI From Here and why it exists.

## Our tools

- [ClosePay](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/closepay): Commission tracking for real estate agents. https://closepay.app
- [Vibizm](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/vibizm): An idea development and execution platform. https://vibizm.com
- [Inspect Sumo](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/inspect-sumo): Turns a home-inspection PDF into a severity-prioritised summary with cost estimates and a repair-request letter. https://inspectsumo.com
- [Nurse K](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/nurse-k): A daily dashboard app for nursing students. https://nurse-k-demo.vercel.app
- [Cobles Landing Reservations](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/cobles-landing-reservations): Booking for a 25-acre family retreat in Polkton, NC. https://cobles-landing-reservations.vercel.app
- [Salintus](https://buildaifromhere.com/tools/salintus): Mental fitness without therapy — a voice-first, non-clinical companion app. https://salintus.com
